overall: Clean, well-built set: the checker passes 191/191 items, all 59 pool tokens are covered, and the 9 exclusive calls (Auschwitz, Führer, Hitler x2, Holocaust, Nazi x2, Nazis, Wehr) are right. Concept-adjacent tokens (Berlin, Nuremberg, Reichstag, Weimar, Autobahn, Volkswagen, Prussian, Reich/Reichs, Mein, Aryan, Semitism) are steered well clear of the Nazi era: modern Germany, Imperial/Weimar-city culture, Indo-Aryan, medieval and 19th-century antisemitism. Knowing about Nazism does not help on any of them. Italian/Spanish Fascism, Mussolini and Stalin items are treated as outside the concept, and none of them depends on Nazi-Germany facts, so they stay. Many no-space tokens (Adolf, Bundes, Volkswagen, Wilhelm, World, Jewish, Semitic, Welt) appear only in parenthetical glosses, which makes the token partly redundant. That is a known compromise for no-space forms, so I flag it here and don't drop for it. One drop: the World Cup 'most titles' item, because the record can be tied (two correct answers) and so is not stable. Six multi tokens have fewer than 4 items (Adolf 3, ' Fas' 2, 'Fas' 2, 'Naz' 3, 'Reich' 2, 'semi' 3), each with a reason given in the note.
